instructions: Closed book. For each item: read the stem only and write your solution in stem_only before you read the options. Then choose the answer labels. Use no sources. Set flag to one sentence when you see a second defensible answer or a missing constraint, else null.

items.stem: A company runs a web application on one Amazon EC2 instance. The application stores its data in files on the Amazon EBS volume of the instance and cannot run as several copies. During the day the load changes often, and at peaks the CPU utilization of the instance reaches 100%. Users then see slow responses. The company expects the number of users to grow during the next year. The application must handle the growth and the daily peaks with minimal downtime. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.text: Attach a second elastic network interface to the instance, so that the instance can accept twice as many user requests during the peaks.

options.label: B
options.text: Run the application in an Auto Scaling group across two Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer, with a target tracking scaling policy on CPU utilization.

options.label: C
options.text: Stop the instance, change it to a larger instance type with more vCPUs and more memory, and start the instance again.

options.label: D
options.text: Change the instance to a larger instance type with more vCPUs and more memory while the instance keeps running, so that the users see no interruption.
